retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the killing of Delfim de Almeida Fernandes by the PRP-BR on 25 February 1980. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.

title: Murder of Delfim de Almeida Fernandes, by the PRP-BR
summary: Wikidata item Q115210882, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "murder on 25-02-1980, in Sintra, Portugal".
